# TypeScript judge-level rules (plugin). Pairs with languages/typescript.md.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: no_unjustified_any_or_non_null
    description: |
      when every use of `any` or a non-null assertion (`!`) in the target files
      carries a comment justifying why the type system is bypassed.
    files:
      include: ["**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx"]
    relevance: the target files use `any` or a non-null assertion

  - name: projects_stay_in_one_js_workspace
    description: |
      true when every TypeScript project in the repo is a member of the root
      workspace (the root `package.json` `workspaces` array, or
      `pnpm-workspace.yaml`), carries its own `package.json` and `tsconfig.json`,
      depends on sibling projects by package name with the `workspace:*` protocol,
      and resolves against the single root lockfile. false when a project is
      invisible to the workspace, commits a second lockfile for the same
      ecosystem, or reaches a sibling through a deep relative path
      (`../other-project/src/...`) instead of a declared workspace dependency. A
      repo with exactly one project, rooted at the repo root, needs no
      `workspaces` array to be true — the claim is that no project resolves
      outside the one root lock.
    files:
      include:
        - "**/package.json"
        - "**/tsconfig*.json"
        - "pnpm-workspace.yaml"
        - "**/bun.lock"
        - "**/bun.lockb"
        - "**/package-lock.json"
        - "**/pnpm-lock.yaml"
        - "**/yarn.lock"
        - "**/project.json"
    relevance: the target files add or change a TypeScript project's manifest, tsconfig, lock, or project definition
